review_candidates.description: AI Platform Engineer (18-Month Contract) Centennial College recognizes and affirms Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Indigenous ways of knowing as central to the vibrancy and uniqueness of its learning and working academic mission. Position Summary Building the future of AI takes more than powerful models. It takes an extraordinary platform behind them. Centennial College is establishing an ambitious AI Incubator to accelerate the development and deployment of artificial intelligence across the institution. From intelligent student services and autonomous AI Agents to AI-powered enterprise workflows, we're creating the technology foundation for a new generation of digital experiences. We're looking for an exceptional AI Platform Engineer to help build, secure, and scale that foundation. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, and cybersecurity—helping establish the enterprise infrastructure that will power Centennial's emerging AI ecosystem. Leveraging Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Entra ID, and modern cloud engineering technologies, you'll design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient AI platform capabilities. You'll help establish reusable infrastructure patterns, automated deployment processes, platform governance controls, and operational practices that support responsible AI innovation. Reporting directly to the Associate Vice President, Strategy, Innovation and Assurance, you'll work within the AI Incubator under the product and delivery direction of the AI Product and Delivery Manager. You'll collaborate closely with AI Development and Data Engineers, enterprise infrastructure teams, cybersecurity specialists, and institutional technology partners. This isn't simply a cloud administration position. It's an opportunity to help architect and operationalize the technology platform behind an institution-wide AI transformation. Responsibilities Build the Cloud Foundation for Enterprise AI Design, configure, secure, and maintain enterprise cloud environments that support AI Agents, intelligent applications, model hosting, and emerging AI workloads. Establish Microsoft Azure subscriptions, landing zones, resource policies, and appropriately segmented development, testing, and production environments. Configure Microsoft Foundry projects, AI hosting services, model endpoints, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform environments in collaboration with authorized service owners. Implement secure identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, role-based access controls, and least-privilege principles. Design and implement secure connectivity between AI platforms and enterprise systems such as Ellucian Banner, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, and other institutional services. Develop reusable cloud infrastructure patterns, deployment templates, and reference architectures that accelerate the delivery of new AI capabilities. Engineer Security, Governance, and Trust Implement security-by-design controls for AI hosting, model access, network isolation, encryption, secrets management, logging, and data protection. Collaborate with cybersecurity, privacy, enterprise architecture, and institutional governance teams to translate approved AI requirements into enforceable technical controls. Configure and maintain governance capabilities using Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Purview, and related technologies. Administer approved Copilot Studio and Power Platform configurations, including environment controls, connector permissions, sharing, and publishing requirements. Secure AI Agent tools, API connections, model endpoints, and supporting cloud resources against unauthorized access and inappropriate use. Identify and address cloud configuration risks, exposed services, insecure credentials, unauthorized connectors, and platform vulnerabilities. Establish clear technical standards, configuration documentation, and operational controls that support secure and auditable AI services. Automate, Scale, and Optimize AI Infrastructure Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, and comparable automation tools. Build and support automated deployment pipelines using GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. Implement platform monitoring, observability, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and related services. Monitor cloud availability, performance, latency, capacity, model utilization, token consumption, and operating costs. Apply cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices to support efficient, sustainable growth of AI services. Develop scalable infrastructure approaches that support changing workloads, evolving AI models, and increasing institutional demand. Move AI from Experimentation to Enterprise Production Collaborate with AI Development and Data Engineers to establish reliable environments for prototyping, testing, deployment, and production operation. Support the deployment and integration of AI Agents, RAG services, model endpoints, enterprise connectors, and related cloud capabilities. Establish release management, backup, recovery, rollback, and disaster recovery procedures for AI platform services. Troubleshoot complex platform issues involving identity, networking, authentication, model quotas, performance, connectivity, and configuration. Develop operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, technical baselines, and support documentation. Evaluate emerging cloud, AI infrastructure, automation, and security technologies for their potential to improve scalability, reliability, and delivery speed. Partner with IT operations and institutional stakeholders to ensure successful AI solutions can transition into secure, sustainable enterprise services. Qualifications/Experience A four-year degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. At least five years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud operations, or a closely related enterprise technical discipline. Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, securing, and operating Microsoft Azure or comparable enterprise cloud environments. Strong understanding of cloud architecture, identity and access management, networking, resource governance, and production operations. Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, private networking, and secure enterprise integration. Experience implementing infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep, or comparable technologies. Proficiency with scripting, automation, source control, CI/CD, and modern DevSecOps practices. Knowledge of cloud monitoring, observability, performance optimization, incident management, and operational reliability. Familiarity with Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or comparable AI hosting technologies is a strong asset. Understanding of cloud security, governance, configuration management, resilience, and cost optimization. Experience supporting enterprise applications across development, testing, and production environments. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, data engineers, cybersecurity specialists, enterprise architects, and operational support teams. A demonstrated interest in AI infrastructure, emerging cloud technologies, and building scalable platforms that enable innovation. What sets you apart? You think like an engineer, automate like a developer, and approach security as a fundamental design principle. You understand that successful AI innovation depends on platforms that are not only powerful, but also reliable, secure, scalable, and sustainable. You enjoy building infrastructure that enables others to move faster. You see automation as an opportunity to eliminate friction, standardization as a way to accelerate innovation, and cloud architecture as an essential foundation for intelligent services. You're equally comfortable experimenting with emerging AI platform capabilities and engineering the controls required to operate them responsibly in an enterprise environment. If you're excited by the opportunity to build the platform that powers the next generation of AI, we want to hear from you. Apply online by clicking the 'Apply' button.
